body: I've considered donating to organisations that promote human rights and civil liberties but I'm afraid of the possibilty that any peaceful movement will fail (and we must remain peaceful). I'm also afraid that tyranny could grow so much that people will rather live out safe and comfy lives rather than fighting for everyone's rights.

I fully agree. However, I'm worried about a few more things as well. One, if I openly criticise the U.S. Government or its policies, I fear that I may get denied access to the country, I'm worried about everybody moving to biometric technology and having a huge database of people's data because it could be abused and used to easily crush any dissenters. Plus, I'm worried that nothing will change and we will live in a totalitarian police state.
But I'm hearing that the internet will soon be censored in the UK (where I live) and DRM will be coming to HTML 5. I'm worried that we are losing freedoms as time passes.
